description: Identify critical workflows understood by too few people, with mitigation plans.
notes: Shared kit was not present at build time; a minimal local Kit fallback is inlined.

notes.note: Making single points of failure visible sounds great until you realize the data is politically explosive — nobody wants to be labeled the bus factor, and managers won't buy a tool that names names. The HRIS-plus-repo integration story is also a privacy minefield. Goodhart's law will eat the metric alive.

notes.change: graph nodes were invisible (shared kit sets border-color on SVG rects, a no-op) and the wide graph was squeezed to 48% scale; promoted node colors to strokes and made it scroll horizontally at 1400px min-width

notes.note: Workflow rows open mitigation plans; zero errors.

notes.change: Mitigation plans now assignable to owners with due dates; new table column shows owner + due-in/overdue chips.
